issues.title: Ingest the Guilford County budget
issues.learned: FY2026-27 General Fund $889,196,646 — K-12 education ($367M) is the largest single item, then Social Services and the Sheriff. All-funds budget $1.19B. The adopted budget book cross-foots to the dollar.

issues.title: Ingest the other funds
issues.detail: Debt service, school capital, rural fire, and grant funds sit outside the General Fund; add them as their own branch.
